adapter: Fixed training-control mean imputation of 32 unavailable inputs; 1968 unambiguous genes scored with original training scales and uniform weights. Seven fixed families; CPA excluded before outcomes.
donor_relabeling: Partition-specific monotone pseudonyms preserve the original donor sort order, including the fixed bootstrap draw order. No original cell identities are exported.
eligibility: At least 16 controls and 8 treated cells for each of three conditions in every eligible donor/context; metadata-only complete condition blocks.
freeze_scope: Locally recorded before GSE181897 expression extraction or model scoring in this project stage; not a public preregistration. Earlier related Parse outcomes informed development. Historical accession searches were bounded and do not establish complete historical non-exposure.
inference_scope: Generalization over exchangeable donors conditional on the observed acquisition pools, admitted adapted models and the single frozen selection split; not new-pool or cross-study population inference. Donor intervals are approximate and assume this conditional donor model.

local_freeze.scope: Local protocol and code were frozen before external outcome analysis; this is not a claim of public preregistration.

numerical_verification.reason: SciPy Student-t quantile implementations differ in final digits. Original frozen expected values are retained; selection labels and joint decisions must match exactly, and the benefit boundary remains strictly zero.

primary_endpoint: Common independent finite-cell effect-target MSE, including its measurement-noise floor; not latent-effect MSE
replay_scope: Independent numerical recomputation from saved per-task model losses. This capsule does not rerun expression preprocessing or neural model inference.
treated_state_secondary: The same frozen effect-selected families are evaluated against the common treated-state measurement. Direct effects add the common deployment input mean; native state predictions retain their state output. Per-seed squared losses are averaged. No state-based reselection or confirmatory state claim.
weighting: Equal eligible donors, equal eligible contexts within donor, equal three conditions. Secondary subsets renormalize these prespecified within-donor weights.
